reading.rule: pre-specified rule of the ensemble seed robustness
reading.criterion_a: LigTerm minus LigTerm-GB: Bond-AUROC, median of the per-study differences >= +0.01 and positive in >= 13 of 19 studies, at the N and at the C terminus
reading.criterion_b: LigTerm minus LigTerm-GB: Length-matched AUC and Near-miss AUC of the both_bonds score, median of the per-study differences > 0 and positive in >= 13 of 19 studies, each
reading.criterion_seed: each single-seed LigTerm-1S minus LigTerm-GB: Bond-AUROC median > 0 and positive in >= 13 of 19 studies, at the N and at the C terminus
reading.conclusion: LigTerm is supported and seed-robust under this rule
